text: Room opened — goal: security: Paranoid guard: scan for leaks/injection; VERIFY elements are REAL (not fake/dead); DETECT

name: Warden
text:
Decision: Run a full, automated security scan on every new build before it goes live.

Reason: This catches leaks and injections early, when they’re cheap to fix. Waiting until after deployment risks real damage—like data leaks or broken systems—that cost way more to clean up. The scan also verifies all parts of the system are real and not dead links or fake endpoints.

Trade-off: It slows down releases a bit, but that’s worth it to avoid a major breach.
